{{Quote|Maybe Dorvalla IV's worth a shot, after all, Captain. If we manage to make it&hellip;I mean, with the Nebula Front likely thinking that we're dead, and all that aurodium right here with us&hellip;|Jalan|<ref name="CoD" />}}
'''Dorvalla IV''' was a [[Planet/Legends|world]] controlled by [[Dorvalla Mining]]. It was the planet beyond their main base, [[Dorvalla/Legends|Dorvalla]]. It was apparently inhabitable by humanoids; whether it actually was is unknown.<ref name="CoD" />

In [[33 BBY/Legends|32.5 BBY]],<ref name="tnec">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' places the events of ''[[Cloak of Deception]]'' in [[33 BBY/Legends|32.5 BBY]].</ref> the crew of [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] [[Arwen Cohl]] wanted to land on Dorvalla IV, but Cohl knew that there were [[Starship/Legends|ships]] under way to [[Dorvalla/Legends|Dorvalla]] and a single shuttle would attract much attention.<ref name="CoD" />
